about: Solomon, sick at sixty and struck by the angel of death, prays for mercy, and an angel of the Lord answers with a rebuke for his many wives and a prophecy of three sons. The Saviour will come from his line and, as Joseph, Moses and Joshua did for Israel, bring his kin out of Sheol.

sentences.n: ወዘከመሂ = ወ- ‘and’ + ዘከመ ‘how, in the way that’ + the enclitic -ሂ (a light emphasis, ‘also, indeed’; the house gloss reads ‘however, in whatever way’, and a plain ‘how’ suits this clause). አዕረፈ ‘he rested’ is the usual euphemism for ‘died’ (3ms perfect, causative stem). እነግረክሙ = እ- (1cs imperfect/subjunctive) of ነገረ ‘tell’ + -ክሙ ‘you (pl.)’. sentences.l: Were his-days 60, and-seized-him sickness, and-as days-of his-father-indeed David not-was but 20: he-fell-short from-him on-account-of that-he-obeyed to-women and-bowed to-idols.
sentences.i: His days numbered sixty, and sickness took hold of him. He did not match the days of his father David but fell short of him by twenty (?), because he submitted to women and bowed down to idols.
sentences.n: ኮነ is 3ms (‘it was’) with a plural subject መዋዕሊሁ ‘his days’ (መዋዕል + -ሁ); the numeral ፷ is ‘sixty’ (years understood). ወአኀዞ = ወ- + አኀዘ ‘seized’ + -ኦ ‘him’. በከመ … -ሰ ‘as for the days of his father David’ (-ሰ marks the contrast). ኢኮነ አላ ፳ … ሐጸ እምኔሁ is compressed: ‘it was not (so), but twenty: he fell short of him (ሐጸ, 3ms perfect; the sense ‘fall short, lack’ is taken from context (?)) by comparison’; my reading of ፳ as ‘twenty short’ is a judgment (?). ዘተአዘዘ ለአንስት: በእንተ ዘ- ‘because of the fact that’ + ተአዘዘ, the T-stem of አዘዘ ‘command’, whose usual sense is ‘obey, submit to’ (rather than the passive ‘was commanded’), with ለ- ‘to’ marking the one obeyed, ‘women’. Compare 1 Kings 11:1–8 (Solomon’s foreign wives and their gods).

sentences.l: And-came angel-of death and-struck-him his-foot, and-wept and-said: O-Lord, God-of Israel, for law-of earthly I-have-been-overcome; for not-is [one] clean from-filth before-you, O-Lord, and-not-is [one] who-is-righteous and-is-wise before-you, O-Lord; for you see and-test heart, and-not-is [one] who-is-hidden from-you; hidden-things you-see among-open-things, and-heart you-examine; have-mercy-on-me, O-Lord;
sentences.i: The angel of death came and struck his foot, and he wept and said: “Lord, God of Israel, for I have been overcome (?) by the law of earthly beings; for no one is clean of filth before you, Lord; and no one is righteous and wise before you, Lord. You see and test the heart, and no one is hidden from you; you see hidden things among the things laid open (?), and you examine the heart. Have mercy on me, Lord;
sentences.n: Narrative verbs are 3ms perfects with ወ-: ወመጽአ ‘and came’, ወዘበጦ ‘and struck him’ (ዘበጠ + -ኦ; the foot, እግሮ, is a second accusative), ወበከየ ‘and wept’, ወይቤ ‘and said’; the prayer starts after ወይቤ. መልአከ ሞት is construct, ‘angel-of death’. እግዚኦ is the vocative ‘O Lord’; እስራኤል depends on the construct አምላከ. ተመዋእኩ is the T-stem passive of መወአ ‘conquer’, 1cs perfect (-ኩ), ‘I have been conquered’ (the stem is my reading) (?); ሕገ መሬታዊ ‘law of the earthly’ I take as ‘the law of mortal creatures’ (?); መሬታዊ is not checked in Dillmann. አልቦ ‘there is not’ takes the accusative: ንጹሐ ‘a clean one’. ዘይጸድቅ ወይጠብብ = ዘ- ‘one who’ + 3ms imperfects ‘is righteous, is wise’. ትሬኢ ‘you see’, ትፈትን ‘you test’, ተሐትት ‘you examine’ are 2ms imperfects. ዘይሴወር ‘who is hidden’ is a passive-sense imperfect of ሰወረ ‘hide’; the exact stem is uncertain (?). ኅቡኣተ ትሬኢ በክሡታት is terse: ‘hidden things you see among/in open ones’ (?). The refrain መሐረኒ እግዚኦ = መሐረ (imperative 2ms) + -ኒ ‘me’, repeated through the prayer. The thought, that no one is blameless before God, echoes Psalm 143:2 and Job 4:17.

sentences.l: Heart-of man you-search and-kidneys you-test; have-mercy-on-me, O-Lord;
sentences.i: You search the heart of man and test the inner parts; have mercy on me, Lord;
sentences.n: ልበ ሰብእ is a construct chain (‘heart-of man’) as the object of ተኀሥሥ (2ms imperfect of ኀሠሠ ‘search’). ኵልያተ is the accusative plural of ኵሊት ‘kidney’ (plural ኵልያት), the seat of feeling and conscience; ትፈትን ‘you test’. This is the biblical formula of God as examiner of hearts and kidneys (Psalm 7:9; Jeremiah 17:10).

sentences.i: You hear the faint (?) and the thunderous; have mercy on me, Lord;
sentences.n: ዘ- ‘that which’ heads two objects: ዘልሑሳስ ‘that of the faint (sound?)’ (?) and ዘረዓም ‘that of thunder (loud noise)’; ትሰምዕ is the 2ms imperfect ‘you hear’. The meaning of ልሑሳስ is uncertain to me, and I take it as ‘faint, soft’ from context, perhaps related to ልሑስ ‘soft, tender’ (?). The point is a merism: God hears the quietest and the loudest speech.

sentences.n: ወእመሰ = ወ- + እመ ‘if’ + -ሰ (contrast). መሐርኮሙ = መሐረ ‘have mercy’, 2ms perfect (-ከ), + -ሙ ‘them’; ለጻድቃን restates the object with ለ-. እለ ‘who (pl.)’ + ኢተዐደዉ, 3mp perfect of ተዐደወ ‘pass beyond, transgress’, with እም- ‘from’ (‘overstepped’, ‘gone beyond’); ትእዛዝከ ‘your commandment’ (ትእዛዝ + -ከ). ምንት መንክር is a verbless question: ‘what (is) wonderful?’; ምሕረትከ ‘your mercy’.

sentences.l: But when you-have-mercy me, sinner, that-indeed wonderful and-pleasing(?) your-mercy; have-mercy-on-me, O-Lord;
sentences.i: But when you have mercy on me, a sinner, that is wonderful and pleasing (?), your mercy; have mercy on me, Lord;
sentences.n: ሶበ ‘when’ + ትምሕር, 2ms imperfect of መሐረ. ኪያየ is the independent accusative pronoun ‘me’ (ኪያ- + -የ), with ኃጥአ ‘sinner’ (accusative) in apposition. ውእቱኬ = ውእቱ ‘that’ + the emphatic enclitic -ኬ (‘that indeed’). መንክር ‘wonderful’ stands without a copula. The meaning of አዳም here is uncertain (?): I read it as an adjective ‘pleasing’ (?) matching መንክር, not the name Adam. The sentence is the answer to the previous one: mercy to the righteous is nothing remarkable, mercy to a sinner is.

sentences.n: From here to the end of the prayer, each line opens with a vocative epithet. አኃዜ is the construct of አኃዚ ‘one who seizes, holds’ (agent noun); its dependents are ዓለም ‘world’ and the plural nouns ነገሥት ‘kings’ and መኳንንት ‘rulers, nobles’, joined by ወ-. Whether ‘holder of’ means ‘ruler over’ or ‘seizer of’ is not settled by the grammar; the context favours ‘ruler of’.

sentences.i: You who make fools wise and the wise foolish: have mercy on me, Lord;
sentences.n: A matched pair of agent nouns in the construct: መጥበቤ ‘one who makes wise’ (causative of ጠበበ ‘be wise’) governing አብዳን ‘fools’, and ማእበዴ ‘one who makes foolish’ (causative of አበደ ‘be foolish’) governing ጠቢባን ‘wise ones’. Both forms are unusual and I read them from the parallelism (?). Compare 1 Corinthians 1:20–27, where God makes the world’s wisdom foolish and chooses the foolish to shame the wise.

sentences.l: And-head-its to-evil on-account-of that-you-multiplied wives, having-transgressed-you his-law and-his-judgment and-his-ordinance of-Lord which wrote Moses and-gave-to-you to-Israel, that not you-take-wives from-other creation except from-your-kin and-house-of your-father, that they-be pure and-holy your-seed, that may-dwell Lord with-you;
sentences.i: The chief of the evil is that you multiplied wives, transgressing the law, judgment and ordinance of the Lord, which Moses wrote and gave to you, Israel, so that you would not take wives from another people except from your own kin and your father’s house, so that your offspring might be pure and holy, and the Lord might dwell with you;
sentences.n: ወርእሳ ለእከይ ‘the head of evil’: ርእስ + -ሃ ‘its’, with ለ- introducing the owner (‘its head, of evil’), i.e. the worst of it. በእንተ ዘ- ‘because (of the fact) that’ + አብዛኅከ, 2ms perfect causative ‘you made many’. ተዐዲወከ is a gerund (2ms, ‘you having transgressed’) with three accusative objects ሕጎ, ፍትሖ, ሥርዐቶ (each + -ኦ ‘his’), the possessor given by ለእግዚኣብሔር. ዘጸሐፈ ሙሴ ‘which Moses wrote’; ወወሀበክሙ ‘and gave to you (pl.)’, with ለእስራኤል in apposition. ከመ ኢታውስቡ: ከመ + 2mp subjunctive of አውሰበ ‘take a wife’; ባዕደ ፍጥረት ‘another creation, i.e. another people’; ዘእንበለ ‘except’. ይኩኑ is plural while ዘርእክሙ ‘your seed’ is singular in form, a loose agreement. Compare Deuteronomy 17:17 (a king must not multiply wives), Deuteronomy 7:3–4 (no intermarriage).

sentences.i: And the foolishness of God is wiser than the wisdom of man, and he gave you only three sons: one who took your glory to a stranger and made the Lord’s dwelling in the land of Ethiopia;
sentences.n: ወእበዲ ለእግዚኣብሔር ‘the foolishness of God’: ለ- carries the owner after the noun (a construct paraphrase). ይጠብብ እም- ‘is wiser than’ (3ms imperfect with comparative እም-). This echoes 1 Corinthians 1:25 (‘the foolishness of God is wiser than men’). In እምጥበቢሁ ለእጓለ እመሕያው the suffix -ሁ ‘his’ anticipates the owner, who follows with ለ- (‘than his wisdom, of the son of man’). እጓለ እመሕያው is ‘offspring of the living’, a common phrase for ‘a human being, son of man’. ኢወሀበከ ‘he did not give you’ + ዘእንበለ ‘except’; the digits ፫ and ፩ are ‘three’ (ሠለስቱ) and ‘one’ (አሐዱ). ዘነሥአ ‘who took’ and ወረሰየ ‘and made’ are perfects with future (prophetic) sense: by the story’s logic this is Menelik (the text does not name him here). ለባዕድ ‘to a stranger, foreign (land)’. ማኅደሮ = ማኅደር ‘dwelling’ + -ኦ ‘his’ (accusative), ብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ ‘the land of Ethiopia’.

sentences.i: and one, the son of a Roman maidservant, who in the last days will uproot Jeroboam and all your kin of Israel; and this land will be his, for he himself believes in the one who is to come, the Saviour;
sentences.n: ሮማዊት is the feminine of ሮማዊ ‘Roman’, qualifying አመት ‘maidservant’; I do not know whom the text means (?). ዘበደኃሪ መዋዕል ‘who in the last days’. ይሤርዎ = ይሤርው (3ms imperfect of ሠረወ ‘uproot, destroy’) + -ኦ ‘him’, the object restated by ለዮርብዓም ‘Jeroboam’; the form could also be 3mp (‘they will uproot him’), and I take it as 3ms (?). ዮርብዓም is Jeroboam, first king of the breakaway northern kingdom (1 Kings 12), a type of rebellious Israel. ትከውን ሎቱ ‘will be to him’ (3fs, agreeing with ምድር); ዛቲ ‘this’ (feminine). የአምን በ- ‘he believes in’; መድኅን ‘Saviour’ (one who saves) is Christ.

sentences.i: But the tribe of Jeroboam and those of Israel who are left will crucify the one who is to come, the Saviour, and your memorial will perish from the earth, because they devise a plan they cannot carry out; and he too will be angry with them and destroy their memorial.
sentences.n: ነገደ ዮርብዓምሰ: -ሰ marks the contrast with the previous clause. ተርፉ ‘remained’ is a 3mp perfect (ተረፈ). ይሰቅልዎ = ይሰቅሉ (3mp imperfect/subjunctive of ሰቀለ ‘hang, crucify’) + -ኦ ‘him’, the object restated by ለዘ ይመጽእ ‘the one who comes’. ይጠፍእ ‘will perish’ (intransitive) versus ያጠፍእ ‘will destroy’ (causative, አ- stem). ዝክርክሙ ‘your memorial’ becomes ዝክሮሙ ‘their memorial’ at the end: the writer shifts person. ይኄልዩ ምክረ ‘they devise a plan’ (cognate accusative); እንተ ‘which’ (feminine, so ምክር is taken as feminine here); አቅሞ = infinitive of አቀመ ‘establish’ (the final -ኦ is most likely the infinitive’s own ending, not ‘it’). ይትመዓዖሙ = ይትመዓዕ ‘he is angry’ + -ሙ ‘them’ (?).

sentences.i: But for you, let Joseph the son of Jacob be a sign, for his brothers sold him to the land of Egypt from Syria, the city of Laban; and when he went down to the land of Egypt, there was a famine in Syria and throughout the world; and when he went down he called his kin and saved them from the famine and gave them a dwelling in the land of Egypt, whose name is Goshen, for he himself was king beneath Pharaoh, the king of Egypt.
sentences.n: ወለከሰ = ወ- + ለከ ‘to you’ + -ሰ (contrast). ይኩንከ = ይኩን, 3ms jussive of ኮነ (‘let it be’), + -ከ ‘to you’; ትእምርተ ‘a sign’ (accusative predicate). ሤጥዎ = ሤጠ ‘sold’, 3mp perfect ሤጡ + -ኦ, contracted to -ጥዎ, + -ኦ ‘him’; አኀዊሁ ‘his brothers’. ብሔረ ግብጽ ‘to the land of Egypt’ is an accusative of direction. ወበርደቱ = ወ- + በ- ‘at’ + ርደት ‘descent’ + -ሁ ‘his’. Verbs of Joseph’s deeds are 3ms perfects with -ሙ ‘them’: ጸውዖሙ, አድኀኖሙ, ወሀቦሙ. እንተ ስማ ‘whose name (fem.)’, ሀገረ ላባ ‘city of Laban’. The text sets the sale in Syria, which differs from Genesis; the story is Genesis 37 and 41–47 (Goshen, Genesis 45:10).

sentences.i: And in the same way the one who is to come, the Saviour, from your kin, will forgive you (?) at his coming and bring you out of Sheol;
sentences.n: From here the chapter applies the type: ወከማሁ = ወ- ‘and’ + ከማሁ ‘likewise, in the same way’ (ከማ- + -ሁ), the answer to every በከመ ‘as’ clause below. ዘይመጽእ መድኅን ‘who comes, a saviour’; ይሰሪ is the 3ms imperfect of ሰረየ ‘forgive’ (?), with ለከ ‘for you’; ‘forgive for you’ is my reading of the construction (?). በምጽአቱ = በ- ‘at’ + ምጽአት ‘coming’ + -ሁ ‘his’. ያወፅአከ = causative (አወፅአ ‘bring out’) 3ms, with -ከ ‘you’. ሲኦል is Sheol, the place of the dead, which the text calls hell in a Christian sense.

sentences.i: and until the Saviour comes you will suffer there with your fathers, and he will bring you out;
sentences.n: ወእስከ ‘and until’ + ይመጽእ ‘he comes’ (subjunctive). ትሣቀይ is the 2ms imperfect of ሠቀየ ‘suffer, be in distress’, taking the sense ‘you will be in torment’ (?). በህየ ‘there’; ምስለ አበዊከ ‘with your fathers’ (አበው + -ከ). The picture is that Solomon and his fathers wait in Sheol until the Saviour releases them, the ‘harrowing of hell’ of Christian tradition.

sentences.i: for from your seed will come a Saviour who will save you, and those before you and those after you, from Adam until his coming, through the line of your kin, and he will bring you out of Sheol;
sentences.n: እምዘርእከ ‘from your seed’ (ዘርእ + -ከ). ዘያድኅነክሙ ‘who will save you (pl.)’: ዘ- + 3ms imperfect of አድኀነ + -ክሙ, followed by ለከ ‘to you (sg.)’ and ወለእለ ‘and to those who’, with እምቅድሜከ ‘from before you’ and እምድኅሬከ ‘from after you’. እምአዳም እስከ ምጽአቱ ‘from Adam until his coming’. በዘመደ ዘመድክሙ ‘by the kin of your kin’ is a stacked construct. The switch between ‘you’ singular (ከ) and plural (ክሙ) is the writer’s: Solomon first, then all those he represents.

sentences.i: As Joseph brought his kin out of the famine (for the first Sheol was in a land of famine), so the Saviour will bring you out of Sheol, you who are his kin;
sentences.n: The type-and-antitype frame: በከመ ‘as, according as’ + a perfect (አውፅኦሙ ‘he brought them out’, causative + -ሙ), answered by ወከማሁ ‘and likewise’ + an imperfect (ያወፅአክሙ ‘he will bring you out’). Expect this pattern in each unit that follows. ለአዝማዲሁ ‘to his kin’ (አዝማድ ‘kin’ + -ሁ) restates the object. ቀዳሚት ሲኦል ‘the first Sheol’, i.e. the land of famine from which Joseph rescued his kin, taken as a figure of the underworld; በምድረ ረኃብ ‘in the land of famine’ (ምድር in construct).

sentences.n: ገቢሮ is a gerund (3ms, ‘having done’) with ትእምርታተ ‘signs’; the subject Moses follows. ዘበጠ ባሕረ ‘struck the sea’ (3ms perfect; Exodus 14:16, 21). አኅለፎሙ = causative of ኀለፈ ‘pass’ + -ሙ ‘them’; እንተ የብስ: እንተ is the feminine relative, and ባሕር is feminine (ትተረጐም in the next unit), so ‘[the sea] which is dry land’; a prepositional ‘by dry land’ is the alternative (?). ይነስት ‘he will break down’ is the 3ms of a verb whose meaning I am inferring from the context (?); አረፋቲሃ ለሲኦል ‘its walls, of Sheol’ (አረፍት, plural አረፋት, ‘wall, enclosure’, uncertain) (?). sentences.n: አንበሮሙ = causative of ነበረ ‘sit, dwell’ + -ሙ ‘them’; ያነብረክሙ is the imperfect + -ክሙ. ፵ ዓመተ ‘forty years’ (accusative of duration). እንዘ + ኢበልየ ‘while … not wore out’ (3ms perfect, singular verb with the plural subject አልባሲሆሙ ‘their garments’). ኢነቅዐ: I read ‘did not swell’ because of Deuteronomy 8:4 (‘your clothing did not wear out nor did your feet swell’); the verb ነቅዐ is more usually ‘gush, burst forth’, so this is inferred (?). ሰኰና is ‘hoof, sole, foot’. ትንሣኤ ‘resurrection’.

sentences.l: And-as he-killed-them Joshua the-seven kings-of Canaan, likewise he-will-kill-them savior the-seven heads-of the-Devil;
sentences.i: And as Joshua killed the seven kings of Canaan, so the Saviour will kill the seven heads of the Devil;
sentences.n: ቀተሎሙ = ቀተለ ‘kill’ (3ms perfect) + -ሙ ‘them’; ይቀትሎሙ is the imperfect. ለ፯ is ለ- + ፯ ‘seven’, spoken ሰብዐቱ (written out in the second half: ለሰብዐቱ አርእስተ አብሊስ ‘the seven heads of Iblis’). The seven nations of Canaan are listed in Deuteronomy 7:1; the seven heads may recall the seven-headed dragon of Revelation 12:3 (?). አብሊስ is the Devil (the form of the name known from Arabic, Iblis).

sentences.l: And-as you built house-of Lord, likewise will-be-built houses-of Lord on heads-of mountains.
sentences.i: And as you built the house of the Lord, so the houses of the Lord will be built on the tops of the mountains.
sentences.n: ሐነጽከ ‘you built’ (2ms perfect of ሐነጸ), the last of the as-clauses, with Solomon himself as the figure: his temple is the type of the churches. ይትሐነጽ is the 3ms imperfect passive (T-stem) ‘will be built’, with a plural subject አብያተ ‘houses-of’ (construct) እግዚኣብሔር. አርእስተ አድባር ‘heads-of mountains’ (ደብር ‘mountain’, plural አድባር). Compare Isaiah 2:2 and Micah 4:1 (the house of the Lord on the top of the mountains). The string ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ is the closing ornament of the chapter.

glossary.በሰይጣን: ሰይጣን — as Satan, by Satan (በ- 'as, by means of' + proper name)
glossary.በሲኦል: ሲኦል — as Sheol, by Sheol (በ- 'as, by means of' + proper noun)
glossary.በስሕተተ: ስሕተት — through the error of (በ- + noun, construct)

glossary.በአጋንንት: ጋኔን — as demons (በ- 'as, by means of' + plural አጋንንት)
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.በክሡታት: ክሡት — among open (things) (በ- + plural ክሡታት, 'laid open, uncovered'; adjective used as noun) (?)
glossary.በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
glossary.በዘመደ: ዘመድ — among the kindred of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ባሕረ: ባሕር — sea (noun, accusative of place 'by sea') · accusative object or goal: 'reached the sea' (ወበጽሑ ባሕረ), 'crossed the sea' (ዐደዉ ባሕረ), 'came out of the sea' (ወወፅኡ ባሕረ), ch. 55 · construct 'sea of' (ባሕረ ኢርትራ 'the Sea of Erythra, the Red Sea')
glossary.ብካየ: ብካይ — weeping (noun, accusative; cognate object of በከየ 'wept', ብካየ መሪረ 'bitter weeping')
glossary.ብዙኀ: ብዙኅ — many, much (adjective, masc. sg., accusative)

glossary.ተርባነ: ተርባነ — unidentified word (?); perhaps an ethnic or titular noun, or a corruption (?)
glossary.ተርፉ: ተረፈ — they remained (3mp perfect, G, t-r-f)
glossary.ተባዕተ: ተባዕት — male (adjective/noun, accusative; ተባዕተ ውሉደ 'male sons')

glossary.ተዐዲወከ: ተዐደወ — you having transgressed (gerund, 2ms, T stem, ʿ-d-w)

glossary.ትሣቀይ: ሠቀየ — you suffer, are in distress (2ms imperfect, G, ś-q-y; the long ā of ትሣቀይ may point to a base ሣቀየ, spelling unchecked) (?)
glossary.ትሬኢ: ርእየ — she sees (3fs imperfect, G) · 2ms 'you see' (ትሬኢ በአዕይንቲከ 'you will see with your eyes')
glossary.ትሰምዕ: ሰምዐ — you hear (2ms imperfect, G, s-m-ʿ)
glossary.ትተረጐም: ተርጐመ — she/it is interpreted (3fs imperfect, T stem passive; agrees with ባሕር)
glossary.ትፈትን: ፈተነ — you test (2ms imperfect, G, f-t-n)
glossary.ኀቤሁ: ኀበ — to him (preposition + -hu, ኀቤሁ) · also 'of him' after ሰአለ 'ask' (ሰአለ ኀቤሁ 'he asked of him')
glossary.ነገሥተ: ንጉሥ — kings (noun, plural ነገሥት, construct 'kings of')
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
glossary.ንጹሐ: ንጹሕ — clean, pure, innocent (adjective; accusative form)
glossary.ንጹሓነ: ንጹሕ — pure, clean (adjective, plural ንጹሓን, accusative)
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አረፋቲሃ: አረፍት — its walls (?) (plural አረፋት + -ሃ '3fs its'; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.አርእስተ: ርእስ — heads, tops (plural አርእስት; construct 'heads of')

glossary.አስጠሞ: ሰጠመ — he drowned him (3ms perfect, causative አ- stem, from ሰጠመ 'sink', + -ኦ '3ms him'; አሰጠመ with the vowel dropped) (?)
glossary.አቅሞ: አቀመ — to establish (infinitive of causative አቀመ, q-w-m, whose ending -ኦ is the infinitive ending; or + -ኦ 'it') (?)
glossary.አበስኩ: አበሰ — I have sinned, done wrong (1cs perfect, G)
glossary.አበዊከ: አብ — your fathers (noun, plural አበው + -ka '2ms your')
glossary.አቡሁሰ: አብ — as for his father (noun, form አቡ- + -ሁ '3ms his' + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.አቡክሙ: አብ — your father (noun, form አቡ- + -ክሙ '2mp your')
glossary.አብኦሙ: አብአ — he brought them in (3ms perfect, causative አ- stem of ቦአ 'enter', + -ሙ '3mp them')

glossary.አኃዜ: አኀዘ — holder, seizer of (construct of agent noun አኃዚ, ʾ-ḫ-z; 'holder-of') (?)
glossary.አኅሰርከ: ኀሰረ — you ruined, brought to loss (2ms perfect, causative አ- stem, ḫ-s-r)
glossary.አንበሮሙ: አንበረ — he made them dwell (3ms perfect, causative አ- stem of ነበረ 'sit, dwell', + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.አንብዑ: አንብዕ — his tears (noun አንብዕ 'tear, tears' + -ሁ '3ms his', written -ዑ)
glossary.አንደይከ: ነደየ — you made poor, impoverished (2ms perfect, causative አ- stem, n-d-y) (?)
glossary.አውፅአክሙ: አውፅአ — he brought you out (3ms perfect, causative አ- stem, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.አውፅኦሙ: አውፅአ — he brought them out (3ms perfect, causative አ- stem, w-ṣ-ʾ, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.አዕረፈ: አዕረፈ — he rested, died, reposed (3ms perfect, causative አ- stem, r-f)
glossary.ኢበልየ: በልየ — it did not wear out (ኢ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-l-y)
glossary.ኢተዐደዉ: ተዐደወ — they did not transgress (ኢ- + 3mp perfect, T stem, ʿ-d-w 'pass beyond')

glossary.ኢኮነ: ኮነ — he did not become (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n) · 'is not' with a predicate (ዝሰ ኢኮነ አምላክ 'this is not a god'; ch. 13)
glossary.ኢይክሉ: ከሀለ — they cannot (ኢ- + 3mp imperfect, G 'be able')
glossary.ኤርትራ: ኤርትራ — Erythra, the Red Sea (proper name; ባሕረ ኤርትራ 'Sea of Erythra')
glossary.እመሕያው: እመሕያው — mankind, human being (noun; compound of እም 'mother' + ሕያው 'living'; genitive after እጓለ)
glossary.እምቅድሜከ: ቅድም — from before you (እም- + ቅድሜ- + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.እምባዕደ: ባዕድ — from another (እም- + ባዕድ, accusative 'other, strange')
glossary.እምቤተ: ቤት — from the house of (እም- + noun, construct)
glossary.እምታሕተ: ታሕተ — from under, under (እም- + preposition ታሕተ)
glossary.እምትእዛዝከ: ትእዛዝ — from your command (እም- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
glossary.እምኔሁ: እም — from (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form እምኔ-) · 'than it', in comparison (ልብሰ ዘይኄይስ እምኔሁ 'a garment better than it')
glossary.እምኔከ: እም — from you (preposition እም with suffix -ኔከ '2ms')
glossary.እምእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — God, the Lord (proper name; እም- 'from, by') · 'than the Lord' in a comparison (ትጠበብ እምእግዚኣብሔር 'you are wiser than the Lord')
glossary.እምዘመድከ: ዘመድ — from your kin (እም- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.እምዘመድክሙ: ዘመድ — from your kin (እም- + noun + -ክሙ '2mp your')
glossary.እምዘርእከ: ዘርእ — from your seed (እም- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.እምግብርናተ: ግብርና — from the servitude of (እም- + ግብርናት, construct) (?)
glossary.እምግብርናት: ግብርና — from servitudes (እም- + plural ግብርናት; abstract) (?)
glossary.እምጥበቢሁ: ጥበብ — than his wisdom (እም- 'than' + ጥበብ + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እነግረክሙ: ነገረ — I will tell you (1cs imperfect/subjunctive, G, n-g-r, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እግሮ: እግር — his foot (noun + -ኦ '3ms his'; accusative, second object after ዘበጦ)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ወለአጋንንቲሁ: ጋኔን — and his demons (ወ- + ለ- + plural አጋንንት + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወለእለ: እለ — and to those who (ወ- + ለ- + relative pronoun pl.)
glossary.ወለከሰ: ለ — and as for you (ወ- + ለ- + -ከ '2ms' + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወለኵሉ: ኵሉ — and to all, for all (ወ- + ለ- + ኵሉ)
glossary.ወልበ: ልብ — and the heart (ወ- + noun, accusative)
glossary.ወመቅሠፍታተ: መቅሠፍት — and plagues, scourges (ወ- + plural መቅሠፍታት, accusative)
glossary.ወመኳንንት: መኰንን — and nobles, governors (ወ- + plural መኳንንት)
glossary.ወመጽአ: መጽአ — and he came (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወማእበዴ: አበደ — and one who makes foolish (ወ- + construct of causative agent noun, ʾ-b-d; read from the parallelism) (?)
glossary.ወረሰየ: ረሰየ — and he made, set (ወ- + 3ms perfect, r-s-y)
glossary.ወርእሳ: ርእስ — and its head (ወ- + noun + -ሃ '3fs its', written -ሳ)
glossary.ወሰራዊቱ: ሰራዊት — and his army (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')

glossary.ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወዐሳዬ: ዐሰየ — and one who rewards (ወ- + construct of agent noun, ʿ-s-y, cf. ዕሴት 'reward') (?)
glossary.ወዘረዓም: ረዓም — and that of thunder (ወ- + ዘ- 'that of' + noun ረዓም 'thunder, loud noise') (?)
glossary.ወዘበጦ: ዘበጠ — and he struck him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, z-b-ṭ, + -ኦ '3ms him')

glossary.ወዘከመሂ: ዘከመ — and however, in whatever way (ወ- 'and' + ዘከመ 'as, how' + enclitic -ሂ)
glossary.ወየኀሥሥ: ኀሠሠ — and he searches (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ḫ-ś-ś); 'wipes' here is a guess from context (?)
glossary.ወየኀትሞሙ: ኀተመ — and he will seal them (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ḫ-t-m, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወያወ: አውፅአ — and he will bring (first half of ወያወፅአክሙ, split by a wordspace in the text; ወ- + ያወ-) (causative አ- stem, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወያወፅአከ: አውፅአ — and he will bring you out (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative አ- stem, w-ṣ-ʾ, + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.ወያወፅአክሙ: አውፅአ — and he will bring you out (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative አ- stem, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ወያጠፍእ: አጠፍአ — and he destroys (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative አ- stem, ṭ-f-ʾ)
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይጠብብ: ጠበበ — and he is wise (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ṭ-b-b)
glossary.ወይጠፍእ: ጠፍአ — and it will perish (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ṭ-f-ʾ)
glossary.ወገቢሮ: ገብረ — and having made (ወ- + gerund, G)
glossary.ወፍትሖ: ፍትሕ — and his judgment (ወ- + noun + -ኦ '3ms his', accusative)
glossary.ወ፩: ፩ — and one (ወ- + numeral); spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one'
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውእቱኬ: ውእቱ — that indeed (3ms pronoun + emphatic enclitic -ኬ)
glossary.ዘለአከኒ: ለአከ — that which / the one who sent me (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, G, l-ʾ-k, + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ዘለዓለም: ለዓለም — everlasting, eternal (ዘ- 'of' + ለዓለም 'for ever'; ክብረ ዘለዓለም 'glory of eternity')
glossary.ዘልሑሳስ: ልሑሳስ — that of the faint (?) (ዘ- 'that of' + ልሑሳስ, a noun or adjective of uncertain sense, perhaps related to ልሑስ 'soft, tender'; no lemma found, so the form itself is given) (?)
glossary.ዘበደኃሪ: ደኃሪ — who in the last (ዘ- + በ- + ደኃሪ 'last, later'; ዘበደኃሪ መዋዕል 'in the last days')
glossary.ዘበጠ: ዘበጠ — he struck (3ms perfect, G, z-b-ṭ)
glossary.ዘተአዘዘ: አዘዘ — command (3ms perfect, passive-reflexive T stem ተአዘዘ 'was commanded'; ዘ- 'that which') · in በእንተ ዘተአዘዘ ለአንስት 'because he obeyed women': ዘ- 'the fact that' + T stem 'obeyed, submitted to', ለ- marking the one obeyed
glossary.ዘትጠበብ: ጠበበ — that you are wise (ዘ- 'that' + 2ms imperfect, G, ṭ-b-b)
glossary.ዘነሥአ: ነሥአ — who took (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ዘአብዛኅከ: ብዝኀ — that you multiplied (ዘ- + 2ms perfect, causative አብዝኀ, b-z-ḫ)
glossary.ዘእነግረከ: ነገረ — what I tell you (ዘ- 'that which' + 1cs imperfect, G, n-g-r, + -ከ 'you')
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘያድኅነክሙ: አድኀነ — who will save you (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, causative አ- stem, d-ḫ-n, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ዘይመጽእ: መጽአ — who comes (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ዘይሴወር: ሰወረ — one who is hidden (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms imperfect, passive sense; root s-w-r 'hide') (?)
glossary.ዘይከውን: ኮነ — who will be (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect)

glossary.ዘጸሐፈ: ጸሐፈ — which he wrote (ዘ- 'which' + 3ms perfect, G, ṣ-ḥ-f)
glossary.የአምን: አመነ — he believes (3ms imperfect, G, ʾ-m-n)
glossary.ያሰጥሞሙ: ሰጠመ — he will drown them (3ms imperfect, causative አ- stem, from ሰጠመ 'sink', + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ያበውአክሙ: አብአ — he will bring you in (3ms imperfect, causative አ- stem of ቦአ, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ያነብረክሙ: አንበረ — he will make you dwell (3ms imperfect, causative አ- stem, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ያወፅአክሙ: አውፅአ — he will bring you out (3ms imperfect, causative አ- stem, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ይመስለከ: መሰለ — it seems to you (3ms imperfect, G, m-s-l, + -ከ '2ms to you')
glossary.ይመጽእ: መጽአ — he comes (3ms subjunctive, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ይሤርዎ: ሠረወ — he will uproot him (3ms imperfect ይሤርው, G, ś-r-w, + -ኦ '3ms him'); could be 3mp (?)
glossary.ይሤርዎሙ: ሠረወ — he will uproot them (3ms imperfect ይሤርው, G, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ይሰሪ: ሰረየ — he forgives (3ms imperfect, G, s-r-y) (?)
glossary.ይሰቅልዎ: ሰቀለ — they will crucify him (3mp imperfect, G, s-q-l, + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ይሴስየክሙ: ሴሰየ — he will feed you (3ms imperfect, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ይቀትሎሙ: ቀተለ — he will kill them (3ms imperfect, G, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይተረጐሙ: ተርጐመ — they are interpreted (3mp imperfect, T stem passive)
glossary.ይተረጐም: ተርጐመ — it is interpreted (3ms imperfect ይተረጐም, passive/reflexive ተ-stem)
glossary.ይትሐነጽ: ሐነጸ — will be built (3ms imperfect, T stem passive, ḥ-n-ṣ)
glossary.ይትመዓዖሙ: ተመዓዐ — he is angry with them (3ms imperfect ይትመዓዕ, T stem, m-ʿ-ʿ, + -ሙ '3mp them'; lemma spelling unchecked) (?)
glossary.ይኄልዩ: ሐለየ — they devise, think (3mp imperfect, G, ḥ-l-y)
glossary.ይኅድር: ኀደረ — he may dwell (3ms subjunctive, G, ḫ-d-r)
glossary.ይነስት: ነሰተ — he will break down (?) (3ms imperfect; the root and sense are inferred from context) (?)
glossary.ይውሕዝ: ወሐዘ — it flows, runs down (3ms imperfect, G, w-ḥ-z)
glossary.ይገብር: ገብረ — he does, makes (3ms imperfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ይጠብብ: ጠበበ — he is wise (3ms imperfect, G, ṭ-b-b) · 'is wiser than' with comparative እም- (ይጠብብ እምጥበቢሁ 'is wiser than his wisdom')
glossary.ዮርብዓምሰ: ዮርብዓም — as for Jeroboam (proper name + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
glossary.ገብርከ: ገብር — your servant (noun + -ከ '2ms your'; in apposition to a name)
glossary.ግብጽ: ግብጽ — Egypt (proper name; genitive after construct)
glossary.ጠቢባን: ጠቢብ — wise men (noun, plural ጠቢባን) · adjective 'wise' used predicatively: እንዘ ጠቢባን 'while wise (ones)'
glossary.ጠቢብአ: ጠቢብ — wise (adjective; the final አ is unexplained, perhaps a slip for accusative ጠቢበ) (?)
glossary.ጸውዖሙ: ጸውዐ — he called them (3ms perfect, G, ṣ-w-ʿ, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ፅአክሙ: አውፅአ — -ፅአክሙ, the rest of ወያወ፡ፅአክሙ 'and he will bring you out' (causative; -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants') · 'one' as a pronoun, 'one … another' (ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'one tells another'; ch. 53)
glossary.፫: ፫ — 3, spoken ሠለስቱ (śälästu) 'three'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'three' (መጠነ ፫ እመት 'to the measure of three cubits'; ፫ ልብስ 'three garments'); spoken ሠለስ (śäläs) (?) before a feminine noun such as እመት, ሠለስቱ with a masculine
glossary.፳: ፳ — 20, spoken ዕሥራ (ʿəśra) 'twenty'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'twenty' (፳ ጻሕለ 'twenty dishes')
glossary.፵: ፵ — 40, spoken አርብዓ (ʾärbəʿa) 'forty'; chapter number (numeral) · counted number 'forty' (፵ ዓመተ 'forty years', unit 24)
glossary.፷ወ፯: ፷ወ፯ — 67, spoken ስሳ ወሰብዐቱ (səssa wä-säbʿätu) 'sixty and seven'; chapter number (numeral, ፷ 60 + ወ- 'and' + ፯ 7)
